How it works

The restoration process

A proper restoration is a system, not a coat of paint. Here's how we take a roof from tired to watertight in five stages.

1

Inspect

We get on the roof, check every tile, cap and flashing, and give you a written quote with honest recommendations.

2

Clean

A high-pressure clean strips away moss, lichen and built-up grime so repairs and coatings bond properly.

3

Repair

Broken tiles are replaced, ridge caps are re-bedded, and any rust, flashing or valley issues are fixed.

4

Point & Seal

Flexible pointing secures the ridge caps, then a primer and sealer lock down the surface ready for coating.

5

Coat

Two coats of premium membrane in your chosen colour — then a final inspection with you before we pack up.

Good questions

Before you book

Roof restoration or full replacement — which do I need?+

If the roof structure and most tiles or sheets are sound, a restoration is almost always the smarter spend — it typically costs a fraction of a replacement and adds many years of life. If we find serious structural damage during the free inspection, we'll tell you honestly and explain your options.

How long does a restoration take?+

Most homes are completed within two to four days depending on roof size, repairs needed and weather. We'll give you a clear schedule in your written quote before any work starts.

Can I choose my roof colour?+

Yes. Our coating systems come in a wide range of colours, including popular Colorbond tones. Many homeowners are surprised how much a colour change lifts the whole look of the house — we'll help you pick a shade that suits your brickwork and gutters.

Do you repair leaks on their own?+

Absolutely. Plenty of our work is standalone repairs — a cracked tile, tired pointing or a rusted valley. We'll fix the cause of the leak, not just the symptom, and let you know if we spot anything else worth attention.

How much does it cost to get started?+

Nothing. Inspections and written quotes are free, with no obligation. Call (02) 9160 3974 or send the enquiry form below and we'll arrange a time that suits you.
